Nikolai Voznesensky.question: In November 1937 he was appointed deputy head of the _____ (Gosplan), of which he was then appointed chairman in 1938 after the previous incumbent, Valery Mezhlauk had been arrested
Nikolai Voznesensky.fact: In November 1937 he was appointed deputy head of the State Planning Committee (Gosplan), of which he was then appointed chairman in 1938 after the previous incumbent, Valery Mezhlauk had been arrested.

Nikolai Voznesensky.question: In December 1947, he published his major work, _____ of the USSR during the Great Patriotic War, which won him a Stalin Prize, and 200,000 ruble prize
